reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "timeline"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "timeline": a trip is a line through time, so scenes travel left to right along it.
Camera "locked": still and precise, so a slow, reading audience is never chasing the frame.
Grounds ink → light → light → accent: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Its shape was 0.74 similar to guide-home-maintenance-you-skip-that-costs-the-most--youtube-short; a different film, not the same one re-coloured.
Most of this audience never unmutes, so nothing depends on sound; cues are kept quieter and sparser for those who do.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on Pinterest video pin (0.32s a word), inside 12–35s.
